02Start with the source

Same schools · same random assignment · different read

The original paper already contains the ingredients.

The new paper is a Track A reanalysis, not a second experiment. It starts with the published attendance package, keeps the original operational outcome, and makes one comparison visible that the aggregate result hides.

What the 2012 article estimates

The Rajasthan experiment randomizes a school-level package: daily camera checks paired with a nonlinear attendance payment. The published headline is teacher presence; the paper also reports learning and child-level outcomes connected to the original nonformal center.

Original article · exact text

What the Track A paper estimates

The final paper keeps the randomized assignment and asks whether the same package changes recorded departure by baseline written-test status. The analysis has 2,195 unique children in 111 schools. Writing status is observed before treatment; it is not randomized and is not treated as a complete ability measure.

one interaction 2,195 children 111 schools exploratory
Final DOCX/PDF supplied separately · extension pp. 6–7

A clue, not the new estimate

The original article points toward heterogeneity.

Its learning discussion reports larger estimated learning gains among children who could already take the written pretest. The Track A paper moves that comparison to the original departure endpoint and tests it directly.

04The comparison map

Original / our extension / what changed

The extension changes one line at a time.

Read the two papers as a sequence of decisions. The treatment, setting, and source package stay anchored; the question, estimand, and interpretation become more specific.

Question
Original

Can monitoring and financial incentives reduce teacher absence and improve learning?

Our extension

Does the same assignment change recorded departure by baseline writing status?

Outcome
Original

School opening, child tests, and aggregate child outcomes including departure and government-school movement.

Our extension

Total recorded departure is primary; destination components remain secondary and incomplete.

Model
Original

Reduced-form treatment effects for the attendance package, alongside a structural labor-supply model.

Our extension

A saturated linear probability model: treatment, writing status, and their interaction. The interaction is the estimand.

Result
Original

Published result: teacher absence falls by about 21 points (school opening rises by about 21 points); aggregate departure rises by about 8 points.

Replication check: reconstructed 20.7 pp opening and 8.4 pp departure.
Our extension

Departure rises 5.0 points for nonwriters and 26.1 for writers. Their direct difference is 21.1 points.

Interpretation
Original

Attendance, learning, and movement are distinct outcomes of a bundled package.

Our extension

The result is exploratory heterogeneity in an operational classification, not proof of dropout, transfer, or a writing mechanism.

Literature
Original

Establishes the Rajasthan setting and reports larger estimated learning gains among baseline writers.

Our extension

Connects monitoring, initial preparation, and recorded-data caution through nine vetted peer-reviewed articles.

These are changes in the recorded classification, not changes in verified school exit. The interaction is statistically distinct under the stated model, but the endpoint remains operational and exploratory.

The endpoint has a rule

Observation comes before interpretation.

Departure is determined from recent open-school checks. Because treatment changes school opening, it also changes the opportunities through which the rule observes children.

Original article · exact text
“last five random checks”
Table 10 definition note · printed p. 1274J-PAL PDF · p. 34 ↗
Final paper · exact text
“The interaction can reflect a change in participation, a change in its observation, or both.”
Measurement and scope · final p. 11DOCX/PDF supplied separately
06Keep the claim bounded

What the new result does not settle

A sharper estimate still has edges.

01

Observation opportunities

More school opening creates more possible checks. In the main sample, 145 children have fewer than five open checks; the last available checks can cover different calendar histories across arms.

02

Recorded destination

Government-school markers and reason fields are incomplete; 66.4% of selected reason fields are blank. Residual departure is not proof that a child stopped studying.

03

Writing is observed, not assigned

Baseline writing status marks the test protocol. It is a pre-treatment comparison margin, not a randomized mechanism or complete literacy measure.

04

The package is bundled

Random assignment identifies cameras plus attendance pay together. The data do not separate a camera effect from a payment effect.

05

Exploratory selection

The departure direction was selected after other candidate extensions were examined. Holm adjustment covers the fixed three-outcome family; it does not erase the broader search history.

The takeaway

The experiment stays the same.
The question gets more precise.

The Track A paper adds a direct comparison across an observed baseline margin. It makes the heterogeneity visible while keeping the result attached to the original roster rule, source data, and unresolved measurement limits.
